SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'class'
  AND s.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'httpx._exceptions')
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id FROM code.calls WHERE callee_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx._exceptions.%' OR callee_name IN (SELECT name FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'httpx._exceptions')))
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;

request:
Which classes defined in httpx/_exceptions.py are not subclassed by any other class anywhere in the repository (tests included)? Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: This query first identifies all class symbols defined in httpx/_exceptions.py, then excludes any that appear as callers in the calls table where the callee references those exception classes (including via dotted paths like httpx._exceptions.SomeException). The remaining symbol IDs are classes with no subclasses anywhere in the repo.
sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
WHERE s.kind = 'class'
  AND s.file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'httpx._exceptions')
  AND s.symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT caller_symbol_id FROM code.calls WHERE callee_symbol_id LIKE 'httpx._exceptions.%' OR callee_name IN (SELECT name FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id IN (SELECT file_id FROM code.files WHERE module = 'httpx._exceptions')))
ORDER BY s.symbol_id;
